What's New in DockFlow 1.77

Improvements

  • Smoother Rapid Preset Switching – Switching presets quickly one after another now jumps straight to the last one you picked instead of working through every switch in turn.
  • No More Getting Stuck – The behind-the-scenes work DockFlow does to rebuild your Dock now gives up and cleans itself up if it takes too long, so the app can't sit there waiting.

Bug Fixes

  • The Window Always Comes Back – Clicking DockFlow in the Dock now always brings the main window to the front — even when Settings or an import window is already open, or the window was minimized.
  • Reopening After Closing – Closing the main window and opening it again now reliably brings back the same window instead of leaving you with nothing on screen.
  • Your Dock Items Stay in Order – Folders, files, and links in a preset now keep the exact order you put them in. Presets whose order got scrambled by an older version are quietly repaired the next time DockFlow starts.
  • Reordering Shows Up Right Away – Moving items around in a preset now updates the list instantly instead of taking a moment to catch up.
  • Deleting an Item Leaves the Rest Alone – Removing a folder or file from a preset no longer shuffles the items that remain.
  • Editing a Preset Is All or Nothing – Preset contents are now saved in a single step. If something goes wrong your preset is left exactly as it was and DockFlow tells you, instead of half-saving the change.
  • Your Remembered Dock Stays Safe – If applying a preset doesn't fully go through, DockFlow no longer overwrites the Dock it saved for you beforehand.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
